open_region: (i) Photon-enriched SVJ (SVJgamma, non-isolated photons, high neutral-EM fraction): no dedicated search found; the CMS hadronic and lepton-enriched SVJ searches explicitly veto events with leading-jet photon-energy fraction >0.7 at pT>1 TeV and use standard jet ID; pheno (2407.08276) claims the inclusive CMS SVJ search has no sensitivity. Status proposed-not-searched. (ii) Photon-ISR-tagged low-mass (~200-700 GeV) Z'->SVJ SVJ: no SVJ search below ~1.5-2 TeV exists (CMS mT>1.5 TeV; ATLAS grid >=2 TeV); jet-ISR boosted variant in preparation at CMS (thesis, mZ'<=550 GeV); visible dijet+photon-ISR searches (ATLAS 200-650 GeV) have no SVJ interpretation, giving at most indirect coverage at small rinv. Photon-ISR SVJ: proposed-not-searched / partly indirectly-covered. Lepton/tau-enriched SVJ: covered (CMS 2608.05323). No HL-LHC SVJ projection document found.
status_label: (i) proposed-not-searched; (ii) proposed-not-searched with partial indirect coverage (low-rinv via dijet+ISR searches) and competing in-preparation CMS jet-ISR analysis; HL: LHC-not-projected-to-HL
hl_projection_docs: None found for SVJ (CMS/ATLAS FTR/PUB); queries on SVJ+HL-LHC returned only reviews (2405.13778, 2403.09292) without dedicated projections - absence not proven

key_caveats: The CMS boosted (jet-ISR) SVJ analysis could be extended to photon-ISR or released with a combined strategy; status of CMS/ATLAS Run-3 SVJ analyses unknown
Photon-enriched SVJ proposers (Cazzaniga et al.) are CMS members; the 2026 ETH thesis INSPIRE 3131301 cites 2407.08276 and may contain a photon-SVJ study - content UNVERIFIED
ATLAS anomaly-detection SVJ region (2505.01634) could have partial sensitivity to SVJgamma depending on jet cleaning - UNVERIFIED
